title: Lines cut
style: cinematic horror film still, vast frozen northern lake under a pale winter sky, lonely ice fishing shacks, black open water, cold steel-blue and white tones with warm lantern amber, dramatic moody lighting, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 2. Whatever is under the circle cuts fishing line clean. Then it gives things back. 🎣

Original fiction. Part 3 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: Wade touched the water in Kettle Lake's unfrozen circle. It was warm. Body warm.
scenes.image: fisherman kneeling at the edge of a round black hole in a frozen lake, steam rising from his bare hand

scenes.narration: By morning the circle is black again. Whatever rose in the night is gone. Wade tells himself it was moonlight.
scenes.image: grey winter morning over a frozen lake, the perfectly round patch of black water still and empty

scenes.narration: But he's a fisherman. So he does what fishermen do. He drops a line.
scenes.image: close-up of a heavy lead sinker and bare hook dangling over still black water from an old ice fishing rod

scenes.narration: It slides in without a splash. Down. And down. Past thirty feet. Past sixty. The spool keeps turning. Kettle Lake is thirty feet deep. Everybody knows that.
scenes.image: close-up of an ice fishing reel spinning fast, line feeding down into dark water

scenes.narration: Then the line goes slack. Wade reels it in. No sinker. No hook. Cut clean, like scissors.
scenes.image: close-up of the cleanly cut end of a fishing line held between a man's gloved fingers, frozen lake behind

scenes.narration: He tries again with a steel leader. Same thing. Cut clean.
scenes.image: man's hands holding a snapped steel fishing leader with a perfectly smooth cut end, harsh winter light

scenes.narration: At the bait shop, old Hank Bell doesn't look up. You dropped a line in the circle. Did it take something? Or give something back?
scenes.image: elderly bait shop owner with a white beard behind a cluttered wooden counter, dim lamp, nets on the walls

scenes.narration: Wade says it took. Hank finally meets his eyes. Then you're lucky. It's still deciding.
scenes.image: close-up of the old man's pale watery eyes staring across the counter, deep worry lines

scenes.narration: That night, something taps on the floor of Wade's shack. From below. Through two feet of ice.
scenes.image: inside a cramped ice fishing shack at night, lantern on the floor, a round fishing hole cut in the ice floor

scenes.narration: He opens the fishing hole. His lost hook is floating there, glinting. Baited. With a curl of grey hair, the same color as his.
scenes.image: close-up of a small fishing hook floating in a dark round hole in ice, a curl of grey hair wrapped around it, lantern light
